CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `outreach_campaigns` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `platform` enum('instagram','soundcloud','both') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'both',
  `targetGenre` varchar(100),
  `minTalentScore` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT 60.00,
  `messageTemplate` text,
  `status` enum('draft','active','paused','completed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `totalTargets` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `contacted` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `responded` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `converted` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `startedAt` timestamp,
  `completedAt` timestamp,
  CONSTRAINT `outreach_campaigns_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  KEY `status_idx` (`status`),
  KEY `created_at_idx` (`createdAt`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `outreach_messages` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `campaignId` int NOT NULL,
  `djId` int NOT NULL,
  `platform` enum('instagram','soundcloud') NOT NULL,
  `messageType` enum('initial','follow_up_1','follow_up_2','custom') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initial',
  `messageContent` text NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','sent','delivered','failed','responded') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `sentAt` timestamp,
  `deliveredAt` timestamp,
  `respondedAt` timestamp,
  `responseContent` text,
  `errorMessage` text,
  `retryCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `scheduledFor` timestamp,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `outreach_messages_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  KEY `campaign_dj_idx` (`campaignId`, `djId`),
  KEY `status_idx` (`status`),
  KEY `scheduled_idx` (`scheduledFor`),
  KEY `sent_at_idx` (`sentAt`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `lead_states` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `djId` int NOT NULL,
  `campaignId` int NOT NULL,
  `currentState` enum('new','contacted','follow_up_1_sent','follow_up_2_sent','responded','interested','converted','not_interested','no_response','dormant') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
  `previousState` enum('new','contacted','follow_up_1_sent','follow_up_2_sent','responded','interested','converted','not_interested','no_response','dormant'),
  `lastContactedAt` timestamp,
  `lastRespondedAt` timestamp,
  `totalMessagesSent` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `totalResponsesReceived` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `conversionDate` timestamp,
  `notes` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `lead_states_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `dj_campaign_idx` (`djId`, `campaignId`),
  KEY `current_state_idx` (`currentState`),
  KEY `last_contacted_idx` (`lastContactedAt`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `closer_config` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `platform` enum('instagram','soundcloud') NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `enabled` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `accountUsername` varchar(255),
  `accountStatus` enum('active','suspended','rate_limited','error') DEFAULT 'active',
  `dailyLimit` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 50,
  `hourlyLimit` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
  `messagesSentToday` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `messagesSentThisHour` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `lastMessageSentAt` timestamp,
  `lastResetAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `config` json,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `closer_config_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
